sloka: उचुश्च परमायस्ता रामम् ज्वलिततेजसम् ।वत्स नैवम् नियुक्तेयम् वनवासे मनस्विनी ॥२-३७-१६॥
transliteration: ucuśca paramāyastā rāmam jvalitatejasam ।vatsa naivam niyukteyam vanavāse manasvinī ॥2-37-16॥

translations.english: Profoundly distressed, they said to Rama glowing with burning lustre O dear, no one has ordered this highminded Sita to dwell in the forest.
